title: Fix View file on outgoing E-Documents to open the exported file
summary: Opening the View file action on outgoing E-Documents now retrieves and downloads the exported file from the document log instead of failing, with appropriate user messages for XML files that cannot be previewed and cases where no exported file exists.
key_points: View file on outgoing E-Documents retrieves the exported file from the document log
Downloaded XML files trigger a message explaining they cannot be previewed inline
Missing exported files show a clear message instead of a record-not-found error
New internal helper and label strings added to support the functionality
quote: Now it finds the exported file from the document log and downloads it, so users don't have to dig through the logs.
